authority: 094-46 GN1-GN5 GL1-GL5 GM2 FN2 FM1 FJ1 FK1 GA2 GA5
plan: Each RHI/size: combined baseline A, baseline B, seal GN2 floor, then combined positive. First two combined positives also are the D4 RHI proofs. Separate default-only runs compare additive output schema/meaning against c5d0919.

combined.pose: qualified far view during complete original texture section; tail near/far only after auto stopped

noise.pixel_norm: max absolute RGB channel difference in integer eight-bit saved PNG values
noise.distribution: 256-bin per-pixel maximum-delta histogram and count strictly above each level for every frame
noise.floor: global maximum pixel delta across both baseline sessions; maximum number of pixels equal to that delta in any pair frame
noise.seal: UTC and SHA256 receipt before positive launch and comparison
noise.unlabelled: frame max <= floor max AND number of pixels equal to floor max <= floor max count
noise.labelled: pixels above floor >1% of frame and greater than max-count floor (zero-delta floor has zero changing noise); report full margins

gates: H4 unchanged for object events; camera whole-frame/no-object-mask entries checked independently. Strict texture IoU >=.98 and clean edges. Every failed measured gate stops subsequent launches.
default_comparison: Every original key and type survives; compare stable values after explicitly reporting run-identity/timing/readback-cost fields, whose values naturally vary by session; no semantic field silently omitted.
